prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Greenvale Metro Communications-Based Train Control System(CBTC): underground/surface; peak/off-peak/engineering; degraded platforms restrictive; automatic-departure restoration requires explicit controller action. Operations Control Centre/Line Traffic Controller regulates approved service; station-holds cannot change route-locking; receives Route Release Exception List for recovery triage. Service Timetable Server supplies schedules/platform-context. Metro Operations Control System(Lantern),non-vital,sends Crew Login Token Bundle,confirms options,reconciles closures/crowding/deviations before passenger release; displays fault summaries,not maintenance commands. Passenger Information Gateway receives reconciled predictions/stopping-pattern/platform-allocation/state; destination/skip-stop publication requires CBTC-confirmed identity/route; closed platforms remain tracked/nonboarding. Voice Dispatch Console displays identity/platform/hold-reason; Revenue Train Operator reads back instructions,maintains readiness,reports hazards/cab-indications/handling/passenger-impacts through degraded-service channel; voice never substitutes safety validation. Dispatch confirmation/cancellation distinct from timeout/failure/rejection. Staff indications require validated normal/held/door-interlock-fault/radio-degraded/emergency-stop/evacuation-support states. North District Zone Controller(Marble)/South District Zone Controller(Orchid): northern/southern mainlines/turnbacks; record health/interfaces/fallback,boundary diagnostics. East Junction Interlocking(Falcon)/West Junction Interlocking retain locking/release authority; report vital points/occupancy/locks,command-histories/detection-changes. Authority requires proved/locked points,overlap/flank/conflict protection,boundary vacancy; mismatches restrict braking-envelope. Falcon sends Axle Counter Reset Request; routes/approaches inhibit reset; Maple(unidentified) verifies/records clearance. West produces Route Release Exception List; hazards persist until excluded. Atlas Onboard Controller(Kestrel): initialization/protected-manual/automatic/fallback/cutout; enforces validated authority/speed/doors/braking; produces Brake Curve Checksum Log,berth/door-side/readiness; stores faults/authority-acceptance/propulsion-cutbacks/interface-exceptions. Dual Channel Odometer disagreement degrades separation; retains speed/distance plausibility. Transfers require position/receiving-zone/isolation/brake-feedback validation. Train Radio Modem logs connectivity/loss/reconnection/quality/retries; requires Encryption Certificate Renewal Pack before renewed secure station/passenger sessions. Wayside Radio Access Network(Saffron) sends Radio Handover Audit File; preserves station

New part:
S167: Failure triage first establishes whether the condition is safety critical, service affecting, cyber security related, or a maintenance-only defect.
S168: Safety critical failures remain under traffic control coordination until the Line Traffic Controller confirms the operating restriction and a Signal Maintenance Engineer confirms the engineering status.
S169: The Maintenance Diagnostic Server preserves raw events, normalised event records, diagnostic session notes, and file integrity values for post-incident analysis.
S170: Configuration records include software build identifiers, parameter set identifiers, radio configuration versions, interlocking data versions, and approved change references.
S171: The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance maintains certificate and key status records used to verify whether communications faults could be related to authentication or expiry conditions.
S172: The Service Timetable Server and Passenger Information Gateway are checked when reported symptoms involve timetable-driven routing assumptions or passenger-facing messages rather than train control protection.
S173: The Voice Dispatch Console is included in the evidence scope when verbal instructions, emergency calls, or manual coordination affected the response to an event.
S174: After a reportable incident, retained evidence is frozen under maintenance control, copied to a protected repository, and released only through the agreed engineering investigation process.
S175: During degraded operation, Greenvale Metro keeps trains stationary or moving at controlled speed until separation assurance is restored.
S176: A degraded mode is declared by the Line Traffic Controller when automatic movement authority, train localization, point detection, platform interface, or radio continuity cannot be trusted.
S177: The Metro Operations Control System shall present the affected limits, the selected fallback mode, and any pending operator actions without obscuring safety alarms.
S178: The Atlas Onboard Controller transitions to restricted manual operation when valid movement authority is unavailable or when onboard location confidence falls below the configured threshold.
S179: The Revenue Train Operator remains responsible for speed control, stopping accuracy, door release discipline, and compliance with verbal movement limits during restricted manual operation.
S180: The Dual Channel Odometer shall cause the train location to be treated as uncertain when its channels disagree beyond the permitted tolerance.
S181: The Train Radio Modem shall report loss of safe data connectivity to the Atlas Onboard Controller and shall not mask intermittent communication failures from the cab display.
S182: A failure in the Wayside Radio Access Network is handled by reducing train throughput before any extension of manual working is considered.
S183: The North District Zone Controller applies the Temporary Speed Restriction Notice only after validating the affected track limits against its degraded-mode map.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
